title: Fix: _merge_reviewed_one checks already_merged before the "branch head moved" void-approval path, so a Planner hand merge (rebase) never opens a review of merged work
spec:
Goal T-0503 hotfix, observed 2026-09-21 01:30: after the Planner merged T-0505 by hand (merge() rebased task/T-0505 onto goal/T-0503, head e96d692 -> 3b74ce7), daemon._merge_reviewed_one saw the worktree head differ from pipeline.reviewed_sha and opened a fresh security review T-0515 of already-merged work (0.5 USD wasted) because the head-moved check runs before already_merged(t). Base goal/T-0503 with T-0510 merged (this is the last daemon.py change in the goal chain). Work only in your worktree, commit only on your own branch with the task id in the message, run the full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh before reporting; report sha and failures only.
1. daemon._merge_reviewed_one: evaluate already_merged(t) (and merged_into set) before the reviewed_sha/head-moved comparison; a merged task returns without opening reviews or notifying. Keep the void-approval behaviour for unmerged tasks whose head moved.
2. Test tests/test_daemon.py::test_merge_reviewed_skips_head_moved_review_for_merged_task (a done task with merged_into set and a worktree head that differs from pipeline.reviewed_sha gets no new review and no notify). Existing tests stay green.
acceptance: tests/test_daemon.py::test_merge_reviewed_skips_head_moved_review_for_merged_task passes: a merged task whose head moved gets no new review task and no notification
unmerged tasks whose head moved after approval still get the fresh review (existing tests stay green)

constraints.interface_contract: no interface change; ordering of checks inside _merge_reviewed_one only

result.summary: superseded by a recreated ordering fix: depends_on is immutable and its dependency T-0510 was superseded
